questions.text: Check that there is a GRV book in place
questions.guidance: "Goods Received Voucher" book. This is a record-keeping tool used to document the receipt of goods into the store. It typically includes details such as the date of receipt, the supplier, the quantity and description of the goods received, and any discrepancies between the order and the delivery. This helps in maintaining accurate inventory records and ensuring that the store has received the correct items in the correct quantities.
